task.description: Re-check of the INV-8 crash-safety BLOCKER fix. Independently re-verify config_from_snapshot/1 and its helpers no longer raise on malformed input, and that attempt_dispatch/2's try/rescue matches Letflow.Scheduler.attempt_fire/2's shape.

result.summary: RECONSTRUCTED HANDOFF -- written 2026-09-03 after the fact; timestamps are reconstructed approximations. Independently re-verified the fix against the current file at reconstruction time. route_kind_atom/1 confirmed to have a catch-all -> {:error, :invalid_route_kind}; method_from_snapshot/1 confirmed to have a catch-all -> {:error, :invalid_method}; config_from_snapshot/1 confirmed to return {:ok, Config.t()} | {:error, atom()} via a with-chain, no bare pattern-match that could fail to match. do_attempt_dispatch/2's {:error, _malformed_reason} clause confirmed to route through handle_failure/4 with :request_build_error, never reaching http_transport/3 or :httpc.request/4 for a malformed row. attempt_dispatch/2's outer try/rescue independently compared side-by-side against Letflow.Scheduler.attempt_fire/2 (lib/letflow/scheduler.ex) -- confirmed structurally identical: a bare try around the Repo.transaction/1 call, a rescue clause converting any exception to {:error, {:raised, exception}}. No new attack surface introduced by the fix (the catch-all clauses only ever narrow behavior -- previously-unmatched input that would have raised now returns a typed error instead; no new code path reaches :httpc.request/4). No confidentiality, injection, or cross-tenant issue found. Overall PASS -- the BLOCKER is resolved with no new discrepancy.
